descriptions.en: A timid rodent that is easily frightened.
descriptions.zh: 一种容易受到惊吓的胆小啮齿动物。

descriptions.en: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.
descriptions.zh: 手感光滑，金星弗鸣克的可爱外观掩盖了它的攻击性。喜欢岩石地形，成群的弗鸣克嗅着空气，寻找泡博的气味——那是它们的主要食物来源。

descriptions.en: Duviri citizens long to understand the Paragrimm’s mysterious, haunting cries, for therein lies much wisdom.
descriptions.zh: 双衍王境的公民渴望理解幽幽鹰那神秘、萦绕的啼声，其中蕴含着丰富的智慧。

descriptions.en: A bird of prey that feeds on fish and kuakas.
descriptions.zh: 一种以鱼类和库阿卡为食的鸟类

descriptions.en: A bird of prey that feeds on fish and kuakas.

descriptions.en: A carrion-eater and opportunistic bird-of-prey. Condrocs gather, feed upon carrion and, occasionally, hunt in groups known as ‘committees'. Several committees will be led by an Emperor.
descriptions.zh: 一种投机取巧的食腐猛禽类生物。秃鹰成群结队以腐肉为食，偶尔也会成群打猎，这种现象被称作"亲卫队"。几名亲卫由一位帝王领导。

descriptions.en: An evasive Vulpaphyla that prefers to run away from fights. Its skills are so profound it can even impart them to their master.
descriptions.zh: 狐帕菲拉性格狡猾，喜欢逃避战斗。其技巧高超到足以传授给主人。

descriptions.en: An evasive Vulpaphyla that prefers to run away from fights. Its skills are so profound it can even impart them to their master.
descriptions.zh: 狐帕菲拉性格狡猾，喜欢逃避战斗。其技巧高超到足以传授给主人。

descriptions.en:
This hardy creature has a collagenous dermis that acts as a thick, protective armor.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
这种强壮的生物有一层厚实的胶原皮层，来充当保护性护甲。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

descriptions.en:
Tactically infectious, this Vulpaphyla weakens enemies to future attacks by inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Status Effects.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
从战术上来说，这种狐帕菲拉具有传染性，它通过造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒异常状态来削弱敌人，为后续攻击创造优势。

仅在"混乱"期间的魔胎之境出现。

descriptions.en: The most abundant variety of Cryptilex, this aggressive insect will slash anything it deems a threat.
descriptions.zh: 数量最庞大的隐疾虫变种，这种虫的攻击性会让它斩断任何它认为有威胁的东西。

descriptions.en: The most abundant variety of Cryptilex, this aggressive insect will slash anything it deems a threat.
descriptions.zh: 数量最庞大的隐疾虫变种，这种虫的攻击性会让它斩断任何它认为有威胁的东西。

descriptions.en: The most dangerous Cryptilex. They have glands in their abdomens that can emit an acidic spray.
descriptions.zh: 最危险的隐疾虫。它们的腹部有可以喷出酸雾的腺体。

descriptions.en: This infectious insect is capable of hazardous viral attacks when alerted.
descriptions.zh: 这种虫的传染性可以让它在警觉时进行危险的病毒攻击。

descriptions.en: A prehistoric bird-like creature that often congregates in small groups.
descriptions.zh: 一种经常小群聚集的史前类鸟生物。

descriptions.en: A prehistoric bird-like creature that often congregates in small groups.
descriptions.zh: 一种经常小群聚集的史前类鸟生物。

descriptions.en:
The rarest of Avichaeas, the Viscid produces a thick, tar-like mucus that it discharges when imperiled.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
最罕见的古羽鸟，在受到威胁时会产生并放出一种类似焦油的浓稠粘液。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

descriptions.en:
This capricious avian unleashes swarms of infested spores as its primary defense mechanism.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
这种反复无常的鸟类可以释放出成群的感染孢子，作为其主要的防御机制。

只有在"秩序"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

descriptions.en: A distinctly Deimosian grotesquerie that attacks its opponents from above.
descriptions.zh: 明显带有火卫二特征的怪兽，会从上方攻击它的对手。

descriptions.en: A distinctly Deimosian grotesquerie that attacks its opponents from above.
descriptions.zh: 明显带有火卫二特征的怪兽，会从上方攻击它的对手。

descriptions.en: Due to its remarkable strength, this Nexifera can cause seismic shocks when hitting the ground.
descriptions.zh: 由于其非凡的强度，这种悬匿兽在撞击地面时可以引起地震冲击。

descriptions.en: The Viridian Nexifera can produce a cloud of poisonous gas that’s always best avoided.
descriptions.zh: 铬绿悬匿兽会产生一团毒气，最好避开为上。

descriptions.en: Unlike most of the highly aggressive life on Deimos, the Vizier Predasite prefers to avoid direct conflict and will instead disable foes from afar. A pack creature, it sheds restorative spores to aid those it considers kin.
descriptions.zh: 与火卫二上大多数极具攻击性的生物不同，宰相扑猎达赛更喜欢避免正面交战，而是从远处击退敌人。作为群居生物，它会释放治愈孢子来帮助那些它认为是同伴的个体。

descriptions.en: A strong and highly aggressive subspecies that can engage groups of enemies with its <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral jaws and incapacitating spores.
descriptions.zh: 一种强大且极具攻击性的亚种，可以用其带有 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒的下颚和使人丧失行动能力的孢子与成群的敌人交战。

descriptions.en: The Pharaoh Predasite prefers to leave as much of the fighting to its master as possible, empowering their master's weapons while making enemies more vulnerable to attacks.
descriptions.zh: 法老扑猎达赛喜欢尽可能将战斗交给主人，自己则专注于增强主人的武器，同时使敌人更容易受到攻击。

descriptions.en: A shy, bizarre-looking, semi-aquatic creature that seldom attacks unless provoked.
descriptions.zh: 一种害羞且看起来有些怪异的半水生生物，只有在被激怒的情况下才会主动攻击。

descriptions.en: A shy, bizarre-looking, semi-aquatic creature that seldom attacks unless provoked.
descriptions.zh: 一种害羞且看起来有些怪异的半水生生物，只有在被激怒的情况下才会主动攻击。

descriptions.en:
The Howler is easily startled. Its penetrating scream will cause other, more dangerous animals to investigate.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
尖啸水螅履虫很容易受到惊吓。其受惊时发出的刺耳尖啸会吸引其他更危险的动物前来一探究竟。

只有在"秩序"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

descriptions.en:
The Vaporous Undazoa gets its name from the noxious gas it belches out when alerted.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
descriptions.zh:
幻雾水螅履虫的命名灵感，源自其会在受到威胁时释放出有毒气体的特性。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

descriptions.en: Tamms delight in soft grass, fresh water, and companionship. Fortune smiles upon the shepherd who provides such things for the gentle Tamm.
descriptions.zh: 塔塔羊喜欢柔软的草地、新鲜的水源和陪伴。幸运将眷顾那些为塔塔羊提供喜爱之物的牧羊者。

descriptions.en: Kexats hunt Paragrimms and Rablits and love to be pampered.
descriptions.zh: 可娃猎杀幽幽鹰与兔纸，并且喜欢被人宠爱。

descriptions.en: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their life to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.
descriptions.zh: 在沿海地区和大片水域周围发现的一种有着荒谬外表的鸟类。秋沙鸟在看到海洋掠食者时会绕圈飞并发出嘎嘎声。多亏了这些奇怪的小鸟许多奥斯唐渔民保住了性命。杀一只是会被认为是凶兆。

descriptions.en: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.
descriptions.zh: 喜欢打雷、闪电和多坑的区域，波雷罗拉的特点就是防御。它们护甲般的外壳可以保护它们免于大多数掠食者之手，缩起来滚走让它们很善于逃跑。

descriptions.en: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.
descriptions.zh: 手感光滑，金星弗鸣克的可爱外观掩盖了它的攻击性。喜欢岩石地形，成群的弗鸣克嗅着空气，寻找泡博的气味——那是它们的主要食物来源。

descriptions.en: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold, but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.
descriptions.zh: 在水体附近可以找到，惑瓦斯克主要靠鱼类维生。这种可怕的生物看起来非常恐怖，但除非被激怒就不会攻击。当它吼叫时，连最坚定的兽夹师都会抖三抖。

descriptions.en: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source for Virmink and Sawgaw.
descriptions.zh: 金星菌类森林的居民，泡博是有着讨厌气味的胆小啮齿类。总是成群行动，一旦发现一点点问题就四散逃窜。它们是弗鸣克和梭歌的主要食物。

descriptions.en: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected Kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.
descriptions.zh: 噬血病毒菌株是一种通过感染的库娃的唾液，来传播的共生血源性病毒。其存在的目的仅仅是为了通过使宿主越来越依赖于血液的摄入，从而让自身在族群中传播的速度越来越快。随着时间的流逝，受噬血型病毒感染的库娃将会失去自我意识，变得越来越狡猾、暴力和贪婪。
